summary: Registered a new sourced lead on the configuration-history mechanism, and recorded a negative result about the documentation: docs/membership.md describes AddVoter as making a server staging and Staging as a promotion path, neither of which matches the current API, so it is a design proposal rather than a contract and I did not use it as normative support. The lead comes from the code — processConfigurationLogEntry advances the committed configuration to the previous latest configuration before installing the new one, without checking that the previous one was committed, while the appendEntries truncation path resets the latest configuration to that committed value — so I registered the question whether a follower can hold a latest configuration naming a server whose configuration entry is no longer in its log, and what it would then do with it, with a discriminator that traces or probes the appending, the withheld commit and the forced truncation together. Four source ranges were recorded for that trace, no defect is asserted yet, and no execution was requested; the four existing questions and their accounts are unchanged.
